overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Chaumont 4 Person Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Constructed from natural Canadian Red Cedar, this sauna features 9 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels strategically placed for optimal heat distribution, promoting muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Ideal for indoor spaces such as basements or fitness rooms, it includes modern amenities like an interior touch screen control panel and Bluetooth connectivity for a personalized experience. With its elegant bronze-tinted tempered glass door and chromotherapy lighting, the Chaumont sauna transforms any space into a serene sanctuary.
